characters.subject: Peasant, weathered oat-brown linen tunic, beige hood, rope belt, dark wool trousers, worn leather boots, small cloth shoulder bag.
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: SMALL low-resolution isometric medieval game sprite sheet, reminiscent of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 people and classic Age of Empires units.
Primary request: ONE tiny simple character in a strict atlas of 4 columns and 8 rows, 32 poses. It should look like actual low-resolution game art, NOT concept art, NOT detailed realistic illustrations. Each sprite uses a logical 64x64 pixel cell; the person is only about 40-48 logical pixels tall and 16-24 wide. Very simple chunky color clusters, restrained 12-color palette, no facial detail, no cloth texture, no thin outlines, readable clothing silhouette. If output is larger, magnify the logical pixel art with crisp square pixels, never add detail.
Layout: 4 equal columns x 8 equal rows, total canvas aspect ratio 1:2 (256x512 logical pixels). Center each person precisely in their cell. Boots at y=58/64 of EVERY cell; head around y=12/64. Empty margin all around, never overlap adjacent cells.
Rows TOP to BOTTOM: S front facing viewer; SW front three-quarter facing left; W left profile; NW back three-quarter left; N back facing away; NE back three-quarter right; E right profile; SE front three-quarter right. Keep the SAME identity, clothes and size across all 32 cells.
Columns LEFT to RIGHT: four walking poses, left-foot-forward, passing, right-foot-forward, opposite passing. Exaggerate tiny leg and arm motions to read at native size. Fixed orthographic camera looking down at 35 degrees. Subtle simple pre-rendered shading.
Background: true transparent alpha, no checkerboard drawn in, no ground, no shadows. No text, no numbers, no borders or grid lines, no additional props or characters.
Subject (simplify all details into solid pixel clusters): Peasant, weathered oat-brown linen tunic, beige hood, rope belt, dark wool trousers, worn leather boots, small cloth shoulder bag.
